Container.Name: pinebridge-tunnel
Container.Overview: Pinebridge: TradingView alerts to MetaTrader 5. Send TradingView alerts straight to MetaTrader 5 on your own Unraid server. No paid signal-relay service, no VPS. This optional container is a Cloudflare Tunnel connector that exposes the pinebridge-bridge webhook to the internet with a stable HTTPS URL and no port-forwarding. Create the tunnel and token in the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard first -- see docs/cloudflare-tunnel-setup.md in the Pinebridge repo. Skip it if you already run a Cloudflare tunnel.
Container.Requires: Create a tunnel in the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard and point its public hostname at http://[your Unraid IP]:5080 (the pinebridge-bridge WebUI Port) before starting this container. Optional: skip this container if you already run a Cloudflare tunnel -- just add a public hostname to it.

Config.Name: TUNNEL_TOKEN
Config.Description: Token for the tunnel you created in the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard
